summary: Frontend-only regression + feature testing of Session 74.11. (P0) ProductInquiryStickyCta refactor (CompactPill/ProductMenu/PulseStyle) verified on Home at 320/390/768/1440/1920px: sticky CTA render, menu with 6 product options, ESC close, click-outside close, dismiss + localStorage, restore pill, pulse sessionStorage, analytics events, nearForm reposition, interstitial hide. (P1) Scroll-Spy on /handeln verified: initial state, scroll activation for all 7 sections, top/bottom edge cases, deep-link #kosten, click-to-scroll, active styling, no jitter, mobile 390px. All functional assertions passed. ONE HIGH UI bug found: the sticky sub-nav (sticky top-0, z-30) is completely hidden behind the site header (sticky, z-100, 114px desktop / 106px mobile) as soon as the user scrolls — so the new scroll-spy highlight is never visible to a real user and the sub-nav buttons are not clickable while scrolled.

ui_bugs.issue: Sub-nav wrapper is 'sticky top-0 z-30' while the global site header is sticky with z-index 100 and height 114px (desktop) / 106px (mobile). While scrolled, the sub-nav sits at viewport top 0..51px, i.e. fully behind the header: document.elementFromPoint() on the sub-nav buttons returns header elements (coveredByHeader=true at 1440px and 390px). The scroll-spy active highlight is therefore invisible and the buttons are unclickable during scrolling (they only work when the page is at the top, in the sub-nav's non-stuck position). Fix: offset the sub-nav (e.g. top-[106px]/top-[114px] or CSS var for header height) or raise z-index above the header, and align NAV_OFFSET (currently 96) with header height + sub-nav height (~165px).

data-near-form attribute is only set on the mobile branch; desktop root has no data-near-form attribute (returns null). Functionally correct (desktop must not reposition) but inconsistent for automated assertions — consider always emitting data-near-form='false' on desktop.

integration_issues.issue: The #invtopic-teaser interstitial (data-visible='true') is displayed around the same scroll depth as #home-newsletter. Because the sticky CTA returns null while the teaser intersects, the nearForm reposition path is unreachable until the teaser is dismissed. Verified nearForm only after closing the teaser (invtopic-teaser-close). Behaviour matches spec priority (hide wins), but worth confirming this is the intended UX.

issues: Font size 10.5px uppercase with 0.18em tracking is at the lower bound of legibility on mobile; active color rgb(76,124,186) on white is acceptable contrast, inactive rgb(100,116,139) is borderline for small caps text.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): offset/raise the /handeln sticky sub-nav so it is not covered by the global sticky header (top-0 z-30 vs header z-100, 114px/106px tall). Without this the new scroll-spy highlight is invisible to users.
Align NAV_OFFSET (96) with actual header (114px desktop / 106px mobile) + sub-nav height after the sticky fix, so section headings are not scrolled under the header.
Optional: emit data-near-form on the desktop CTA root for test parity.
critical_code_review_comments: HandelnHub.jsx is 866 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; SECTIONS/BOERSEN_ABC data and useScrollSpy should be extracted into separate modules.

useScrollSpy: IntersectionObserver + one passive lightweight scroll handler only (verified) — performance is fine; pickActive() re-queries getBoundingClientRect per intersecting section only, acceptable.
useScrollSpy deps: [ids] with SECTION_IDS as a module-level constant — stable, no re-subscribe loop (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all functional assertions pass; 1 HIGH visibility/clickability defect on the sticky sub-nav)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bypass the visitor gate by evaluating localStorage.setItem('kapitalmitte_visitor_profile', ...) and localStorage.setItem('kapitalmitte_cookie_consent', {preferences:{...}}) then page.reload() — the 'Akzeptieren' button is disabled until a role is chosen. To test the sticky-CTA nearForm behaviour you must first close the #invtopic-teaser interstitial ([data-testid='invtopic-teaser-close']), otherwise the CTA is intentionally not rendered. Note: the automation tool errors with 'str() takes at most 3 arguments' if the screenshot path is built via string concatenation — use literal paths. Re-verify the /handeln sticky sub-nav offset fix (must be visible below the 106-114px header while scrolled).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the HIGH bug: the /handeln sub-nav container uses 'sticky top-0 z-30' while the global site header is itself sticky at top 0 with z-index 100 and a height of 114px (desktop) / 106px (mobile). When the sub-nav sticks, it renders in the 0-51px band already occupied by the higher-stacked header, so it is painted underneath and hit-testing on its buttons returns header nodes (verified via elementsFromPoint at 1440px and 390px after window.scrollTo(0,3000)). Scroll-spy state itself is correct (data-active flips as expected); only the presentation/interaction layer is broken. Mitigation: set the sub-nav sticky offset to the header height (CSS var / top-[114px] with a mobile variant) and update NAV_OFFSET accordingly.
